name: Sorin Markov
description: Sorin Markov is an ancient vampire planeswalker, lord and protector of Innistrad, who created the angel Avacyn and helped imprison the Eldrazi on Zendikar.

description_citations.text: "Sorin Markov". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

summary.text: Sorin Markov is an ancient vampire planeswalker, lord and protector of Innistrad, who created the angel Avacyn and helped imprison the Eldrazi on Zendikar.

citations.text: "Sorin Markov". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

bio.text: With Ugin and Nahiri he helps focus the power that completes the hedron network and imprisons the Eldrazi on Zendikar.

citations.text: "The Lithomancer" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Oct 2014.

bio.text: He travels to Tarkir to find Ugin and, in the altered timeline, wakes him and tells him the Eldrazi are free.

citations.text: "Sorin's Revelation" by Adam Lee. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Sep 2014.
"Sorin's Restoration" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Mar 2015.
"Sorin's Restoration" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Mar 2015.

bio.text: On Innistrad he asks Olivia Voldaren for help against a threat, and then destroys Avacyn by performing his creation ritual in reverse.

citations.text: "Promises Old and New" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Apr 2016.
"I Am Avacyn" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 May 2016.

bio.text: He hurls his former protege Nahiri into the Helvault, and after her release she calls Emrakul to Innistrad and traps him in a stone cocoon, where Olivia leaves him.

citations.text: "Stone and Blood" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jun 2016.
"Campaign of Vengeance" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Jul 2016.
"Campaign of Vengeance" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Jul 2016.

bio.text: Years later he refuses to give Arlinn the Moonsilver Key, then tries to stop Olivia's wedding to his grandfather Edgar.

citations.work: Episode 3: The Fall of the House of Betzold
citations.text: "Episode 3: The Fall of the House of Betzold" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Sep 2021.
"Episode 3: Forever Hold Your Peace" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Nov 2021.

bio.text: Edgar defeats him and throws him into a pit, but Sorin heals with the pit's blood, duels Edgar in the ballroom and spares his life.

citations.text: "Episode 4: The Wedding Crashers" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Nov 2021.

bio.text: A 2026 account says he betrayed Edgar by imprisoning him in the Helvault.

citations.text: "The Legends of Reality Fracture" by Meris Mullaley, Christopher Stuart-Reckling, K. Arsenault Rivera, DK Billins. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Sep 2026.

status.text: Sorin is alive, and his last major event shows him sparing his grandfather Edgar after defeating him in the ballroom, while a later mention places him shoring up Innistrad's defenses with Arlinn.

timeline.summary: Sorin creates Avacyn and the Helvault and imprisons Nahiri inside it.
timeline.quote: Sorin Markov creates Avacyn and the Helvault .

citation.text: "Timeline", section "War with Phyrexia (3285 AR to 4206 AR) [ 17 ]". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Nissa breaks the central hedron in the Eye of Ugin, freeing the Eldrazi Titans.
timeline.quote: Nissa breaking the central hedron in the Eye of Ugin

citation.text: "Timeline", section "The Mending Era (4500 AR to 4562 AR)". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sorin releases Ugin from his hedron cocoon.
timeline.quote: Sorin Markov arrives on Tarkir and releases Ugin from his Hedron cocoon.

citation.text: "Timeline", section "The Mending Era (4500 AR to 4562 AR)". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sorin Markov says he has seen planes leveled and life reduced to dust, which brought no pleasure even to his dark heart.
timeline.quote: I have seen planes leveled and all life rendered to dust.

citation.text: Day of Judgment (Zendikar Promos, 2009), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Sorin Markov criticizes vampires who gorge without savoring the kill.
timeline.quote: The vampires of this world don't know the pleasures of hunger.

citation.text: Feast of Blood (Zendikar, 2009), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Nissa, Sorin and Anowon cross Makindi, endure the Roil, meet the kor prophet Smara and battle hazards.
timeline.quote: met the kor prophet Smara

citation.text: "Makindi", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ugin, a lithomancer and Sorin Markov trap the Eldrazi on Zendikar with a lock-spell at the Eye of Ugin and leave.
timeline.quote: the planeswalkers trapped the Eldrazi on Zendikar

citation.text: "Gods and Monsters". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Mar 2010. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Sorin Markov and Nissa Revane free Anowon, who accompanies them to the Eye of Ugin.
timeline.quote: until he was freed by Sorin Markov and Nissa Revane on the outskirts of Turntimber forest.

citation.text: "Anowon", section "Enslavement and Return to the Eye". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Nissa's actions release the Eldrazi Titans and Anowon flees with the planeswalkers to Affa, where they part ways.
timeline.quote: they fled together to Affa where they parted ways.

citation.text: "Anowon", section "Enslavement and Return to the Eye". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sorin Markov, Ugin and Nahiri decide to rid the Multiverse of the Eldrazi; Ugin helps imprison them on Zendikar instead.
timeline.quote: Ugin told them that it wouldn't be a good idea to destroy them and instead helped them imprison the Eldrazi on the plane of Zendikar.

citation.text: "Eldrazi", section "Three against three". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sorin lures the Eldrazi, Ugin binds them with colorless magic and Nahiri's hedron network forms the prison bars.
timeline.quote: Sorin Markov lured the Eldrazi to the plane, directing their hunger to that unique mana

citation.text: "Eldrazi", section "Imprisonment". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Eldrazi manifest on Zendikar, are confined and sink into dormancy; the planeswalkers disband, Nahiri staying to guard the prison.
timeline.quote: Sorin and Ugin left the plane, while Nahiri remained to watch over Zendikar and protect the Eldrazi's prison.

citation.text: "Eldrazi", section "Imprisonment". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Nissa shatters the main Hedron and releases the enchantment imprisoning the titans, and Sorin washes his hands of her.
timeline.quote: she shattered the main Hedron and released the enchantment imprisoning the titans.

citation.text: "Eldrazi", section "Release of the Eldrazi". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ugin, Nahiri and Sorin devise and build a hedron and leyline network on Zendikar to trap the Eldrazi.
timeline.quote: They devised a plan to trap the Eldrazi by creating a complex network of leylines, hedrons , and nodes of mana.

citation.text: "Emrakul", section "Imprisonment of the Eldrazi". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Titans arrive at Zendikar in -1400 AR and the three planeswalkers fight them.
timeline.quote: Ulamog , Kozilek , and the towering Emrakul descended upon Zendikar

citation.text: "Emrakul", section "Imprisonment of the Eldrazi". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The three planeswalkers combine their magic at the Eye of Ugin to activate the hedron network, sealing the Titans in stone.
timeline.quote: Every hedron on Zendikar shifted into place, sealing the Titans in a prison of mana and stone.

citation.text: "Emrakul", section "Imprisonment of the Eldrazi". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sorin, Nahiri and Ugin ally against the Eldrazi but cannot defeat them, and instead imprison them on Zendikar with a hedron network centered on the Eye of Ugin.
timeline.quote: Instead of killing the Eldrazi, they caused the Imprisonment of the Eldrazi on Zendikar.

citation.text: "Eye of Ugin", section "Imprisonment". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The three planeswalkers seal the Eye with a lock that needs three planeswalker sparks and Ugin's breath, then disband.
timeline.quote: Their mission complete, the planeswalkers disbanded.

citation.text: "Eye of Ugin", section "First breaking". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Vampires build a shrine near the Eye, destabilizing the prison; Nahiri awakens, calls for help in vain, restores the prison alone, then leaves to find Sorin.
timeline.quote: She succeeded on her own, and restored the prison.

citation.text: "Eye of Ugin", section "First breaking". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sorin returns, frees Anowon and goes with Nissa to the Eye, where Nissa shatters the main hedron, releasing the Eldrazi; Sorin leaves the plane.
timeline.quote: she shattered the main Hedron and released the enchantment imprisoning the titans

citation.text: "Eye of Ugin", section "Release of the Eldrazi". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ugin, Nahiri and Sorin devise a trap network of leylines, hedrons and mana nodes on Zendikar, with Nahiri building it and Ugin inscribing runes.
timeline.quote: They devised a plan to trap the Eldrazi by creating a complex network of leylines, hedrons , and nodes of mana.

citation.text: "Kozilek", section "Imprisonment of the Eldrazi". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The three planeswalkers fight, converge at the Eye of Ugin and activate the hedron network, sealing the titans in a prison of mana and stone.
timeline.quote: Every hedron on Zendikar shifted into place, sealing the Titans in a prison of mana and stone.

citation.text: "Kozilek", section "Imprisonment of the Eldrazi". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Nahiri's spark ignites and she lands on Innistrad, where Sorin decides to mentor her.
timeline.quote: Instead of chasing the young and confused Planeswalker off the plane, Sorin decided to mentor Nahiri

citation.text: "Nahiri", section "The Three against the Eldrazi". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Three plan to trap the Eldrazi on Zendikar; Sorin lures them, Ugin binds them and Nahiri builds the hedron prison.
timeline.quote: Nahiri constructed a massive network of stone hedrons

citation.text: "Nahiri", section "The Three against the Eldrazi". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The imprisonment succeeds, The Three disband, and Sorin and Ugin leave, promising to come if Nahiri signals.
timeline.quote: With the Imprisonment of the Eldrazi , the planeswalkers' mission was complete, and The Three disbanded.

citation.text: "Nahiri", section "The Three against the Eldrazi". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Vampires build a shrine at the hedron nexus, destabilizing the prison; Nahiri wakes, calls unanswered for help and restores it alone.

timeline.summary: Sorin Markov arrives in time to save Nissa from the brood.

citation.text: "Zendikar: In the Teeth of Akoum", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

citation.text: "Zendikar: In the Teeth of Akoum", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

citation.text: "Zendikar: In the Teeth of Akoum", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

citation.text: "Zendikar: In the Teeth of Akoum", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

citation.text: "Zendikar: In the Teeth of Akoum", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

citation.text: "Zendikar: In the Teeth of Akoum", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.quote: Instead of Ajani and Liliana, we see Gideon and Sorin.

citation.text: "Core Curriculum". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Jul 2011. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Sorin's Vengeance depicts Sorin ramming his blade into a would-be swordsman's heart, drawing the victim's blood up the blade into himself.
timeline.quote: Sorin's Vengeance depicts him ramming said blade into the heart of a victim

citation.text: "M12 from the Inside, Part 2". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Jul 2011. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Sorin creates the archangel Avacyn to maintain equilibrium between humans and monsters on Innistrad.
timeline.quote: Sorin Markov created the archangel Avacyn to maintain an equilibrium between humans and the monsters that preyed on them

timeline.quote: He traded knowledge of Sifa for the dagger and the lives of the Cathars.

citation.text: "Dack Fayden", section "Innistrad". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Edgar Markov inflicted vampirism on his grandson Sorin, awakening Sorin's planeswalker spark.
timeline.quote: Edgar inflicted his curse of vampirism on his grandson Sorin, awakening Sorin's latent planeswalker's spark .

citation.text: "Helvault", section "Birth of vampirism". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Edgar forces his grandson Sorin to turn, igniting Sorin's planeswalker spark.
timeline.quote: the trauma of the transformation caused the boy's planeswalker spark to ignite

citation.text: "Innistrad (plane)", section "Birth of Vampirism". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sorin forges the angel Avacyn to protect humanity from the vampires, along with the Helvault, and is reviled as a traitor by most vampires.
timeline.quote: Sorin forged a warrior who could hold back the vampires and other threats

citation.text: "Innistrad (plane)", section "Creation of Avacyn". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After Nahiri confronts him over the lost Zendikar signal, Sorin banishes her into the Helvault following a clash with Avacyn.
timeline.quote: Sorin called the battle off and banished Nahiri into the Helvault.

citation.text: "Innistrad (plane)", section "Imprisoning Nahiri". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Nahiri confronts Sorin on Innistrad, threatens him, fights Avacyn and is imprisoned by Sorin in the Helvault.
timeline.quote: The two fought until Sorin ended the battle by imprisoning Nahiri in the Helvault.

citation.text: "Nahiri", section "Imprisoned on Innistrad". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

citation.text: "Sorin Markov", section "Avacyn". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

citation.text: "Sorin Markov", section "The Ancient Fang". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sorin sees vampires dwindling the human villages and creates the angel Avacyn to protect Innistrad, giving rise to the Church of Avacyn.

citation.text: "Sorin's Homecoming". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Jan 2012. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Most vampires revile Sorin as a traitor for creating Avacyn and he is no longer welcome at Markov Manor.

timeline.quote: Edgar inflicted his curse of vampirism on his grandson, Sorin, awakening Sorin's latent planeswalker spark.

citation.text: "The Prison of Silver". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2012. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Sorin returns to Innistrad after centuries and creates the archangel Avacyn to safeguard humanity.
timeline.quote: He created the archangel Avacyn to safeguard humanity

citation.text: "The Prison of Silver". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2012. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Avacyn and her angels slaughter vampires, werewolves, geists and ghouls; Sorin's kin brand him a traitor.
timeline.quote: They slew vampires with holy fervor, prompting Sorin's kin to brand him a traitor to their kind.

citation.text: "The Prison of Silver". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2012. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Sorin Markov laments that only the shadow of his creation, the archangel, remains.
timeline.quote: Now only her shadow remains.

citation.text: Vault of the Archangel (Dark Ascension, 2012), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Sorin created the archangel Avacyn to safeguard humanity.
timeline.quote: He created the archangel Avacyn to safeguard humanity

citation.text: "Helvault", section "Creation of Avacyn and the Helvault". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sorin fashioned the Helvault from a chunk of the silver moon using lithomancy learned from Nahiri.
timeline.quote: Sorin fashioned it from a chunk of the plane's silver moon .

citation.text: "Helvault", section "Creation of Avacyn and the Helvault". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Freed from the Helvault, Nahiri finds Zendikar ravaged, swears vengeance on Sorin and destroys Markov Manor.
timeline.quote: She attacked Markov Manor , destroying it with lithomancy

citation.text: "Innistrad (plane)", section "The Travails". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sorin finds Markov Manor in ruins and seeks help from Olivia Voldaren.
timeline.quote: His search brought him to the remote estate of the powerful Olivia Voldaren

citation.text: "Innistrad (plane)", section "The Travails". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: With the Helvault sundered, Nahiri returns to a ravaged Zendikar and swears vengeance on Sorin.
timeline.quote: she swore vengeance against Sorin

citation.text: "Nahiri", section "Revenge". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Nahiri wounds and encases Sorin in stone at Markov Manor and planeswalks away.
timeline.quote: Nahiri was wounded severely but managed to encase Sorin in stone.

citation.text: "Nahiri", section "Revenge". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sorin creates the Helvault so Avacyn can seal away threats; she battles demons such as Ormendahl for about a thousand years.
timeline.quote: and sealing them within the Helvault

citation.text: "Sundering of the Helvault", section "Background". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Hundreds of years earlier, Nahiri seeks Sorin's aid; provoked, he has Avacyn imprison her in the Helvault.
timeline.quote: the resulting confrontation led to Nahiri’s imprisonment within the vault

citation.text: "Sundering of the Helvault", section "Background". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Nahiri, embittered, planeswalks to Zendikar.
timeline.quote: She planeswalked away to her home world of Zendikar

citation.text: "Sundering of the Helvault", section "Consequences". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In BOOM! Comics, Sorin Markov binds Sengir in a pocket dimension with obelisks.
timeline.quote: so he erected obelisks in the dwarven city and bound him in a pocket dimension, along with the dwarven vampires.

citation.text: "Sengir", section "BOOM! Comics". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The journal says Sorin created Avacyn to hold the vampires in check and that the church keeps humans as livestock, never able to defeat them; Dovid concludes his faith is a lie.
timeline.quote: We are livestock. We are unwitting participants in our own cultivation.

citation.text: "The Lunarch's Journal" by Colin Kawakami. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Aug 2014.

timeline.summary: Sorin arrives on Tarkir in search of the spirit dragon Ugin, led by an oracle's visions toward a dragon-head mountain peak.
timeline.quote: Somewhere up there was his destination.

citation.text: "Sorin's Revelation" by Adam Lee. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Sep 2014.

timeline.summary: Sorin dominates a warrior sentry and drains him dry to feed.
timeline.quote: drained him to a pale husk.

citation.text: "Sorin's Revelation" by Adam Lee. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Sep 2014.

timeline.summary: Sorin worries over Nahiri's silence and Ugin's absence while the Eldrazi titans rampage on Zendikar.
timeline.quote: The Eldrazi titans were a fire that could not be quenched, and Ugin's absence was strange.

citation.text: "Sorin's Revelation" by Adam Lee. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Sep 2014.

timeline.summary: A Temur band mistakes Sorin for a Sultai demon-spawn and Sorin kills two warriors with death magic and raises them as vampire thralls.
timeline.quote: Sorin reached out his hand and willed the two leathery corpses back from the dead.

citation.text: "Sorin's Revelation" by Adam Lee. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Sep 2014.

timeline.summary: Sorin turns Rushka against his captain, who beheads him, and a vampire thrall drains the captain.
timeline.quote: the captain reacted like a cat and struck the shaman's head off with one blow from his jawbone axe.

citation.text: "Sorin's Revelation" by Adam Lee. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Sep 2014.

timeline.summary: Sorin dominates a surviving warrior to serve as his guide to Ugin.
timeline.quote: You shall serve me,

citation.text: "Sorin's Revelation" by Adam Lee. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Sep 2014.

timeline.summary: The Temur guide tells Sorin that dragons have been hunted to extinction and that the Spirit Dragon gave the Temur magic to fight corrupted dragons.
timeline.quote: But some say that the dragons became greedy and corrupt, so the Spirit Dragon gave us magic to fight them.

citation.text: "Sorin's Revelation" by Adam Lee. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Sep 2014.

timeline.summary: The guide leads Sorin to a chasm where only huge bones lie, and Sorin refuses to believe it is Ugin.
timeline.quote: That cannot be Ugin.

citation.text: "Sorin's Revelation" by Adam Lee. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Sep 2014.

timeline.summary: Sorin descends into the chasm, finds Ugin's skull in the ice and discovers Ugin is dead.
timeline.quote: Ugin was dead. And with him fell the hopes of countless worlds.

citation.text: "Sorin's Revelation" by Adam Lee. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Sep 2014.

timeline.summary: Sorin fears Zendikar and then Innistrad will be consumed and says they are all doomed.
timeline.quote: We're all doomed,

citation.text: "Sorin's Revelation" by Adam Lee. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Sep 2014.

timeline.summary: Sorin Markov taunts the entombed Ugin.
timeline.quote: Here you lie then, Ugin.

citation.text: Bitter Revelation (Khans of Tarkir, 2014), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan is sent back in time from the valley, and Sorin's Restoration awakens Ugin, breaking the crucible.
timeline.quote: Sarkhan Vol was sent back in time from this location

citation.text: "Qal Sisma", section "Known locations". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan goes through the Nexus of Fate and saves Ugin by encasing him in hedrons; Sorin's Restoration later frees him in 4559.
timeline.quote: In 4559 Sorin's Restoration broke the crucible and restored Ugin to life.

citation.text: "Qal Sisma", section "Historical". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sorin visits Tarkir and, in the current timeline, awakens Ugin with Sorin's Restoration; Ugin tells him to find Nahiri.
timeline.quote: Sorin's Restoration awakened Ugin from his slumber

citation.text: "Sorin Markov", section "Current timeline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sorin's vampire progeny on Tarkir are sacrificed in the new timeline to break Ugin's cocoon.
timeline.quote: in the new timeline, they were sacrificed to break Ugin's hedron cocoon

citation.text: "Vampire", section "Tarkir". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sorin urges Nahiri to leave the refugees and focus on stopping the creatures before they spread to other worlds; Nahiri insists they are there to save the people.
timeline.quote: I'm here to stop these creatures, on this world, before they spread to others—to mine, or to yours.

citation.text: "The Lithomancer" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Oct 2014.

timeline.summary: Sorin admits that they are not winning against the creatures.
timeline.quote: No," he said.

citation.text: "The Lithomancer" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Oct 2014.

timeline.summary: Nahiri, Sorin and Lian fight the first wave of Eldrazi brood at the wall, but the titan's pull drains their magic.
timeline.quote: Nahiri could feel her mana spiraling away even as she gathered it.

citation.text: "The Lithomancer" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Oct 2014.

timeline.summary: The plane begins to come apart as a crack in the world opens and the refugees are swept away.
timeline.quote: The plane was coming apart.

citation.text: "The Lithomancer" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Oct 2014.

timeline.summary: Sorin flashes away and Lian is taken by the light; Nahiri grabs the sword and planeswalks off the dying world.
timeline.quote: Silently cursing herself, Nahiri grabbed the sword and left the world behind.

citation.text: "The Lithomancer" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Oct 2014.

timeline.summary: Nahiri and Sorin regroup at a kor settlement in Akoum on Zendikar.
timeline.quote: Nahiri clutched the sword, the last trace of a now-dead world.

citation.text: "The Lithomancer" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Oct 2014.

timeline.summary: Ugin appears as a luminous dragon, and Nahiri meets him for the first time.
timeline.quote: Then he was there with them: a massive, ethereal dragon, shining with blue-white light.

citation.text: "The Lithomancer" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Oct 2014.

timeline.summary: Ugin reveals he watched the destruction without helping, in order to learn about the Eldrazi, and explains what they are and why they cannot simply be killed.
timeline.quote: They're called the Eldrazi," said Ugin, "and they devour entire worlds.

citation.text: "The Lithomancer" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Oct 2014.

timeline.summary: Ugin proposes imprisoning the three true Eldrazi on a single plane, binding them with physical anchors and forcing them into dormancy.
timeline.quote: Bind them to one plane using their physical forms as anchors, and force them into dormancy.

citation.text: "The Lithomancer" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Oct 2014.

timeline.summary: Ugin describes the ideal prison world, and Nahiri realizes he means Zendikar, refusing at first.
timeline.quote: What gives me the right to put everyone here in danger?

citation.text: "The Lithomancer" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Oct 2014.

timeline.summary: The three titans Ulamog, Kozilek, and Emrakul arrive on Zendikar, and Ugin and Sorin fight their brood as the titans march toward the hedron nexus.
timeline.quote: Ugin breathed his ghostfire, searing the Eldrazi brood with invisible flame.

citation.text: "The Lithomancer" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Oct 2014.

timeline.summary: Nahiri, Sorin and Ugin focus their power in the Eye of Ugin and shift every hedron into its final position, completing the network.
timeline.quote: Every single hedron on the plane glowed as they shifted into new positions.

citation.text: "The Lithomancer" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Oct 2014.

timeline.summary: The three Eldrazi stand petrified over Akoum and the chamber is sealed with a lock that requires three Planeswalkers to open.
timeline.quote: Looming above the highlands of Akoum, the three Eldrazi stood petrified, surrounded by a web of floating hedrons.

citation.text: "The Lithomancer" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Oct 2014.

timeline.summary: Nahiri vows that her work is just beginning as she looks up at the imprisoned titans.
timeline.quote: My work is just beginning.

citation.text: "The Lithomancer" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Oct 2014.

timeline.summary: Ugin traps the Eldrazi on Zendikar, learning little from Sorin but the rudiments of lithomancy from Nahiri.
timeline.quote: While trapping the Eldrazi on Zendikar, Ugin learned little from Sorin

citation.text: Ugin's Construct (Ugin's Fate, 2015), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Sorin's Restoration awakens Ugin and he leaves Tarkir in 4559 AR, lessening the dragonstorms.
timeline.quote: the spirit dragon departed Tarkir in 4559 AR, the dragonstorms, no longer empowered by his essence, finally lessened.

citation.text: "Tarkir", section "Nexus of Fate". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sorin arrives on Tarkir, uneasy beneath the sun, searching for Ugin who may be dead and guided only by an oracle's vague visions.
timeline.quote: His only guide now was a cluster of vague impressions given to him by an oracle.

citation.text: "Sorin's Restoration" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Mar 2015.

timeline.summary: A party of Atarka warriors mistakes Sorin for a Silumgar death-spawn and threatens to take his head.
timeline.quote: Your head will decorate a spear tonight.

citation.text: "Sorin's Restoration" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Mar 2015.

timeline.summary: Sorin enthralls a warrior as a guide and learns from him that the khans fell, the dragons now rule, and Ugin dwells in the Haven.
timeline.quote: Ugin is the beating heart of the world. He dwells within the Haven.

citation.text: "Sorin's Restoration" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Mar 2015.

timeline.summary: Sorin sees the hedron cocoon in a chasm and wonders if Nahiri was there.
timeline.quote: Lithomancy on Tarkir? Had Nahiri traveled here before him and bested the dragon?

citation.text: "Sorin's Restoration" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Mar 2015.

timeline.summary: Sorin drains the thrall of what blood remains and uses blood magic to destroy the hedron shard and unmake the cocoon, freeing Ugin.
timeline.quote: The hedron shard crumbled to dust, and the cocoon began to crack.

citation.text: "Sorin's Restoration" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Mar 2015.

timeline.summary: Ugin explodes from the ruins, recognizes Sorin, and says he was saved after Bolas attacked him using his own dragons.
timeline.quote: He thought me his rival for power, and attacked me. Used my own dragons against me.

citation.text: "Sorin's Restoration" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Mar 2015.

timeline.summary: Sorin tells Ugin that over a thousand years have passed and the Eldrazi have escaped their hedron prison on Zendikar, partly through Nissa's choice.
timeline.quote: They're free." Sorin had the urge to press the matter, to needle Ugin, to make someone else shoulder the blame.

citation.text: "Sorin's Restoration" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Mar 2015.

timeline.summary: Ugin asks about Nahiri, and Sorin evasively says she lives but is not on Zendikar; Ugin insists all three of them must work together.
timeline.quote: Let me be clear. It must be the three of us.

citation.text: "Sorin's Restoration" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Mar 2015.

timeline.summary: Ugin agrees to join Sorin at the Eye of Ugin, and Sorin planeswalks away from Tarkir.
timeline.quote: I will join you at the Eye soon.

citation.text: "Sorin's Restoration" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Mar 2015.

timeline.summary: Sorin Markov performs a ritual that sunders the hedrons and frees Ugin in 4559 AR.
timeline.quote: performed a ritual that sundered the hedrons, freeing Ugin from his long slumber

citation.text: "Crucible of the Spirit Dragon", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sorin Markov arrives on Tarkir and releases Ugin from his hedron cocoon.
timeline.quote: Sorin Markov arrives on Tarkir and releases Ugin from his Hedron cocoon.

citation.text: "Tarkir/Timeline", section "Dragons of Tarkir". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ugin recounts that Sorin Markov woke him and spoke of foolishness at the Eye.
timeline.quote: An ally of mine, a vampire and a Planeswalker, woke me up and spoke to me of 'foolishness at the Eye.'

citation.text: "Unbroken and Unbowed" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Apr 2015.

timeline.summary: Sorin fights through Temur hunters, makes a vampire guide and finds Ugin dead in the canyon, concluding the Multiverse is doomed.
timeline.quote: Ugin is long since dead, and Sorin concludes that the Multiverse is doomed.

citation.text: "The Story of Tarkir Block". Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Apr 2015.

timeline.summary: Six thousand years earlier, Nahiri and Sorin fail to save an unknown plane from the Eldrazi, then agree with Ugin to imprison the titans on Zendikar.
timeline.quote: The trap is sprung, the titans are subdued, and Nahiri settles in for a long vigil to keep them imprisoned.

citation.text: "The Story of Tarkir Block". Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Apr 2015.

timeline.summary: Sorin, with no memory of an earlier visit, destroys the cocoon and awakens Ugin, who tells him the Eldrazi are free.
timeline.quote: Sorin destroys the cocoon and awakens Ugin.

citation.text: "The Story of Tarkir Block". Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Apr 2015.

timeline.summary: Ugin insists it must be the three of them, and Sorin agrees to find Nahiri and meet Ugin on Zendikar.
timeline.quote: Reluctantly, Sorin agrees to seek out Nahiri and meet Ugin on Zendikar to stop the Eldrazi.

citation.text: "The Story of Tarkir Block". Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Apr 2015.

timeline.summary: Nahiri frees herself from her cocoon, goes to the great hedron, and sends a summons to Sorin and the Spirit Dragon.
timeline.quote: she sent her call into the Æther

citation.text: "Stirring from Slumber" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 May 2015.

timeline.summary: After waiting, Nahiri realizes Sorin and the Spirit Dragon have not come and she is alone.
timeline.quote: They hadn't come. Sorin hadn't come. She was alone.

citation.text: "Stirring from Slumber" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 May 2015.

timeline.summary: Nahiri, angry that Sorin abandoned her, decides to find him and wake him, and opens a pathway through the Blind Eternities to another plane.
timeline.quote: eager to find her oldest friend.

citation.text: "Stirring from Slumber" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 May 2015.

timeline.summary: Sorin Markov crushes Liliana in a duel.
timeline.quote: They dueled, and Sorin crushed her and pronounced her too weak to be a threat.

citation.text: "Liliana Vess", section "Early life". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Nahiri, Ugin and Sorin Markov use hedrons to trap the Eldrazi on Zendikar.
timeline.quote: Together with Ugin and Sorin Markov she used them to trap the horrendous Eldrazi on the plane.

citation.text: "Battle for Zendikar", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After Nissa releases the Titans, Emrakul vanishes and is drawn to Innistrad by Nahiri, who wants revenge on Sorin.
timeline.quote: She was drawn through the Blind Eternities to the plane of Innistrad by the planeswalker Nahiri

citation.text: "Emrakul", section "The Eldrazi released". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Avacyn holds Emrakul at bay until Sorin unmakes her, and then Emrakul enters Innistrad physically.
timeline.quote: once she was unmade by Sorin, the titan physically entered Innistrad

citation.text: "Emrakul", section "The Eldrazi released". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sorin returns to Zendikar, allying with Nissa and freeing Anowon to reach the Eye of Ugin.
timeline.quote: he liberated the vampiric slave Anowon and demanded that the two take him to the Eye of Ugin

citation.text: "Sorin Markov", section "Return to Zendikar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sorin reveals his mission and nature to Nissa on the voyage to Akoum.
timeline.quote: Sorin finally told Nissa the nature of their mission, as well as admitting to being a walker much like her.

citation.text: "Sorin Markov", section "Return to Zendikar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Nissa persuades Brinelin to lead them through the crystal reefs by telling him of Sutina's death.
timeline.quote: Brinelin finally acquiesced to lead them safely through the crystal reefs.

citation.text: "Sorin Markov", section "Return to Zendikar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Nissa shatters the main hedron at the Eye of Ugin, releasing the Eldrazi, and Sorin washes his hands of her and Zendikar.
timeline.quote: she shattered the main Hedron and released the enchantment imprisoning the titans

citation.text: "Sorin Markov", section "Return to Zendikar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sorin's Restoration awakens Ugin from his cocoon of hedrons, and Ugin learns the Eldrazi have awakened.
timeline.quote: With Sorin's Restoration , the vampire awakened and freed the spirit dragon from his slumber.

citation.text: "Ugin", section "Awakening". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jace commits to helping, and Ugin asks him to find Sorin Markov, whom he warns not to trust, or else Nahiri.
timeline.quote: If you want to help, then seek him out, bring him here, but . . . do not trust him.

citation.text: "Revelation at the Eye" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Oct 2015.

timeline.summary: Ugin, Nahiri and Sorin imprison the Eldrazi titans on Zendikar using a network of hedrons built by Nahiri.
timeline.quote: The Planeswalkers' trap worked.

citation.text: "Battle for Zendikar Story Summary" by Mel Li. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Dec 2015.

timeline.summary: A little over a thousand years ago the Eldrazi nearly escape and Nahiri restores their prison alone, then goes to check on her absent allies and is not seen again.
timeline.quote: Nahiri restored the Eldrazi's prison on her own

citation.text: "Battle for Zendikar Story Summary" by Mel Li. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Dec 2015.

timeline.summary: Sorin returns with Nissa to seal the Eye, but Nissa breaks the last bonds and the Eldrazi titans emerge.
timeline.quote: she broke the last bonds holding them in, and the titans emerged into the world.

citation.text: "Battle for Zendikar Story Summary" by Mel Li. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Dec 2015.

timeline.summary: Sorin unmakes Avacyn after Emrakul's corruption.
timeline.quote: Emrakul's corruption forces Sorin to unmake Avacyn.

citation.text: "Timeline", section "Gatewatch Period". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ugin scolds the planeswalkers for killing two ancient beings, says he will study their remains, tells Jace to leave, and warns of Sorin and Bolas.
timeline.quote: have proven to be an extremely arrogant and unreliable partner.

citation.text: "Zendikar Resurgent". Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Feb 2016.

timeline.summary: Ugin departs, and Jace and Gideon decide that Jace will go to Innistrad to find Sorin Markov.
timeline.quote: I'll go to Innistrad and find Sorin.

citation.text: "Zendikar Resurgent". Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Feb 2016.

timeline.summary: Jace reveals he is looking for Sorin Markov, surprising Liliana.
timeline.quote: I'm looking for Sorin Markov,

citation.text: "Unwelcome" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Mar 2016.

timeline.summary: Jace explains that Sorin helped trap the Eldrazi on Zendikar and that Jace and two other planeswalkers inadvertently freed them (recounted).
timeline.quote: Manipulated and coerced, two other Planeswalkers and I inadvertently released the Eldrazi titans from their prison.

citation.text: "Unwelcome" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Mar 2016.

timeline.summary: Liliana recalls her one meeting with Sorin long ago, when he tested and dismissed her and warned her to be a civil guest (recounted).
timeline.quote: He sought me out, tested my strength in battle, and pronounced me too weak to be a threat.

citation.text: "Unwelcome" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Mar 2016.

timeline.summary: Liliana warns Jace not to seek Sorin, saying he is ancient, ruthless and powerful.
timeline.quote: And I am telling you, don't go.

citation.text: "Unwelcome" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Mar 2016.

timeline.summary: Jace reads in the journal that Sorin made Avacyn to protect humans so that vampires would not overfeed.
timeline.quote: Sorin made her.

citation.text: "The Mystery of Markov Manor" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Mar 2016.

timeline.summary: Jace concludes that the angels have gone mad and turned on the humans, and someone tore apart the manor.
timeline.quote: The angels have turned on the human populace.

citation.text: "The Mystery of Markov Manor" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Mar 2016.

timeline.summary: Jace resolves that the journal will help him find Sorin through the angels.
timeline.quote: This will help me find Sorin.

citation.text: "The Mystery of Markov Manor" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Mar 2016.

timeline.summary: Nahiri visits Markov Manor and sends Sorin a clear message.
timeline.quote: The message was clear to Sorin—Nahiri had paid Markov Manor a visit.

citation.text: Declaration in Stone (Shadows over Innistrad Promos, 2016), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Sorin must end Avacyn, whom he created.
timeline.quote: Sorin had created Avacyn, so it was a cruelty beyond imagining, a pain beyond description, that it fell upon him to end her forever.

citation.text: Anguished Unmaking (Shadows over Innistrad Promos, 2016), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Jace is sent to find Sorin and finds Markov Manor and evidence of a deeper mystery.
timeline.quote: Sent to find Sorin, Jace ventured to the vampire's ancestral home, only to find evidence of a deeper mystery.

citation.text: Foreboding Ruins (Shadows over Innistrad Promos, 2016), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Nahiri vows to take everything from Sorin.
timeline.quote: Sorin, I'm going to take everything from you.

citation.text: Nahiri's Machinations (Shadows over Innistrad, 2016), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Nahiri compares Zendikar's bleeding to what Innistrad and Sorin will suffer.
timeline.quote: As Zendikar has bled, so will Innistrad. As I have wept, so will Sorin.

citation.text: Structural Distortion (Shadows over Innistrad, 2016), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Olivia Voldaren summons her bloodline to Lurenbraum Fortress at Sorin's appeal.
timeline.quote: At Sorin's appeal, Olivia Voldaren summoned the full might of her bloodline to gather at Lurenbraum Fortress.

citation.text: Call the Bloodline (Shadows over Innistrad, 2016), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Nahiri summons Emrakul to Innistrad to take revenge on Sorin; Avacyn and the angels go mad, and Emrakul corrupts inhabitants.
timeline.quote: She was summoned to Innistrad by Nahiri to take revenge on Sorin, and her presence drove Avacyn and the angels to madness.

citation.text: "Eldrazi", section "Shadows over Innistrad". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sorin recruits Olivia against Nahiri; she requires that he kill Avacyn, and they raise a vampire army.
timeline.quote: Sorin and Olivia assembled a vampire army and went to war against Nahiri.

citation.text: "Olivia Voldaren", section "Shadows over Innistrad". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Nahiri defeats Sorin and encases him in stone; Olivia proclaims herself lord of Innistrad and takes his sword.
timeline.quote: Olivia proclaimed herself the new lord of Innistrad and took his sword from him.

citation.text: "Olivia Voldaren", section "Shadows over Innistrad". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sorin searches for the whereabouts of Nahiri.
timeline.quote: Meanwhile, Sorin is in search of the whereabouts of Nahiri

citation.text: "Shadows over Innistrad", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sorin walks through Olivia Voldaren's masked ballroom to confront her.
timeline.quote: A hundred or more pairs of eyes watched him from behind elegant masks as he made his way across the ballroom.

citation.text: "Promises Old and New" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Apr 2016.

timeline.summary: Olivia mocks Sorin and orders him thrown out, saying the scion of Edgar Markov is not welcome.
timeline.quote: The scion of Edgar Markov is not welcome here

citation.text: "Promises Old and New" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Apr 2016.

timeline.summary: Sorin cuts down five of Olivia's vampires and blasts the last, a duelist, to ash with a clenched fist.
timeline.quote: his assailant's body burst apart in a scattering of ashes

citation.text: "Promises Old and New" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Apr 2016.

timeline.summary: Sorin tells Olivia he has come for her help.
timeline.quote: I have come for your help.

citation.text: "Promises Old and New" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Apr 2016.

timeline.summary: Sorin tells Olivia that his grandfather's manor is in ruins; Olivia blames Avacyn and says she destroyed Castle Falkenrath.
timeline.quote: She's already destroyed Castle Falkenrath and scattered that bloodline.

citation.text: "Promises Old and New" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Apr 2016.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Sorin, still weakened from creating Avacyn, is pulled from his restoration by the arrival of another planeswalker.
timeline.quote: Something had pulled him prematurely from his restoration.

citation.text: "Promises Old and New" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Apr 2016.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Sorin finds the lithomancer Nahiri beside the Helvault.
timeline.quote: Sorin knew her immediately.

citation.text: "Promises Old and New" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Apr 2016.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Nahiri says the Eldrazi broke free of their bonds and she resealed their prison alone.
timeline.quote: With all the strength I could muster, I managed to reseal the titans' prison.

citation.text: "Promises Old and New" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Apr 2016.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Sorin explains the Helvault is half of what he created to protect Innistrad, perhaps blocking her signal.
timeline.quote: This Helvault is half of what I created to serve as such protection.

citation.text: "Promises Old and New" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Apr 2016.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Nahiri accuses Sorin of abandoning her and breaking their agreement; Sorin dismisses her, recalling that he took her under his wing.
timeline.quote: When your Planeswalker spark first ignited, it was I who discovered you.

citation.text: "Promises Old and New" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Apr 2016.

timeline.summary: Sorin tells Olivia he created Avacyn to protect the world, and that a dangerous person has come to threaten it.
timeline.quote: I created her to be this world's protector.

citation.text: "Promises Old and New" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Apr 2016.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Nahiri raises a field of floating stones, forges a sword from stone and demands Sorin return with her to Zendikar.
timeline.quote: You will return with me to Zendikar.

citation.text: "Promises Old and New" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Apr 2016.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Sorin blocks Nahiri's sword, disarms her and holds a blade to her throat, ending the fight.
timeline.quote: Sorin brought the point of his blade up to her throat.

citation.text: "Promises Old and New" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Apr 2016.

timeline.summary: Sorin asks Olivia to summon her bloodline to join the Markov remnants against the threat.
timeline.quote: Summon the might of your bloodline, Olivia.

citation.text: "Promises Old and New" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Apr 2016.

timeline.summary: Olivia agrees to help Sorin, on the condition that he first helps her.
timeline.quote: I will help you. But first you will help me.

citation.text: "Promises Old and New" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Apr 2016.

timeline.summary: Sorin crashes through the skylight into the cathedral and blocks Avacyn.
timeline.quote: I look up to see the skylight explode, a man crashing through it feet first.

citation.text: "I Am Avacyn" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 May 2016.

timeline.summary: Sorin tells Avacyn something is wrong with her and that he has come to help.
timeline.quote: There's something wrong with you, Avacyn

citation.text: "I Am Avacyn" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 May 2016.

timeline.summary: Avacyn hurls holy magic at Sorin twice, but he is unharmed.
timeline.quote: I hurl the holy magic at him, and it hits him full in the chest.

citation.text: "I Am Avacyn" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 May 2016.

timeline.summary: Sorin reveals he is Avacyn's creator, which is why she cannot harm him.
timeline.quote: I am your creator

citation.text: "I Am Avacyn" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 May 2016.

timeline.summary: Avacyn recognizes Sorin as the reason she exists, who gave her mission to protect.
timeline.quote: He is the reason I exist.

citation.text: "I Am Avacyn" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 May 2016.

timeline.summary: Avacyn condemns Sorin as the greatest evil of the world for creating her flawed.
timeline.quote: Sorin Markov, I condemn you as the greatest evil of this world.

citation.text: "I Am Avacyn" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 May 2016.

timeline.summary: Avacyn lunges at Sorin with her spear but misses him.
timeline.quote: I lunge with the spear, using every bit of my divine strength.

citation.text: "I Am Avacyn" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 May 2016.

timeline.summary: Avacyn summons the angels from the rafters to attack Sorin.
timeline.quote: He looks up to see the angels I have called down on him.

citation.text: "I Am Avacyn" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 May 2016.

timeline.summary: Sorin destroys Avacyn's angels one by one, draining one.
timeline.quote: One by one he destroys my angels.

citation.text: "I Am Avacyn" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 May 2016.

timeline.summary: Avacyn, seeing Sorin as a monster, can finally harm him and slashes his neck.
timeline.quote: I slash my spear through his neck, cutting deep enough to hit bone.

citation.text: "I Am Avacyn" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 May 2016.

timeline.summary: Avacyn drives her spear through Sorin's chest plate and into the wall.
timeline.quote: I sink my spear through the gap in the monster's chest plate, so deep that the blade hits the granite of the cathedral wall on the other side.

citation.text: "I Am Avacyn" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 May 2016.

timeline.summary: Sorin reveals his full strength, pins Avacyn and bites her neck.
timeline.quote: He bites my neck, and the pain is like a thousand innocents screaming

citation.text: "I Am Avacyn" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 May 2016.

timeline.summary: Sorin drives Avacyn through the cathedral floor into the cellar where she was made.
timeline.quote: When we slam to a halt, we lie in the cellar of Thraben Cathedral

citation.text: "I Am Avacyn" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 May 2016.

timeline.summary: Sorin offers to cleanse her mind and remake her; Avacyn refuses to be anyone's instrument.
timeline.quote: I am no monster's instrument. I will not be altered by the likes of you.

citation.text: "I Am Avacyn" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 May 2016.

timeline.summary: Sorin destroys Avacyn by performing a ritual in reverse, revoking his gift, and she dies with a final prayer.
timeline.quote: words of a ritual performed in reverse, words of a gift being revoked.

citation.text: "I Am Avacyn" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 May 2016.

timeline.summary: Jace demands to know what Sorin has done as Avacyn is gone, leaving the cathedral vacant.
timeline.quote: Avacyn was no more. The cathedral felt overly large now, somehow.

citation.text: "I Am Avacyn" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 May 2016.

timeline.summary: Sorin sheathes his sword and leaves up the stairs as Jace asks what he has done.
timeline.quote: Jace watched Sorin shove his sword into his scabbard and turn away

citation.text: "I Am Avacyn" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 May 2016.

timeline.summary: Sorin appears behind Nahiri and she greets him joyfully.
timeline.quote: My friend!" she managed to say at last. "You're alive!

citation.text: "Stone and Blood" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Nahiri tells Sorin she resealed the Eldrazi prison alone after neither he nor Ugin answered her signal.
timeline.quote: With all the strength I could muster, I managed to reseal the titans' prison.

citation.text: "Stone and Blood" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Sorin reveals the Helvault may have blocked Nahiri's signal and shows no concern.
timeline.quote: This Helvault is half of what I created to serve as such a protection.

citation.text: "Stone and Blood" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Early in their acquaintance, Sorin broke Nahiri's arm in a lesson and told her she was no longer mortal.
timeline.quote: You broke my arm!

citation.text: "Stone and Blood" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Nahiri accuses Sorin of abandoning her and breaking their agreement.
timeline.quote: You risked my plane, and more.

citation.text: "Stone and Blood" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Recounted: Nahiri stood watch over the imprisoned Eldrazi for five thousand years, then fought them off alone when they escaped.
timeline.quote: For five thousand years, Nahiri stood watch over their monstrous prisoners.

citation.text: "Stone and Blood" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Sorin tells Nahiri he owes her nothing and that he molded her, telling her to bother Ugin instead.
timeline.quote: I took you under my wing, and molded you into what you are

citation.text: "Stone and Blood" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Nahiri calls up a granite column and swirling stone darts, declaring she is not going anywhere.
timeline.quote: She called forth a column of rock from the depths beneath them

citation.text: "Stone and Blood" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Nahiri's stone column swallows Sorin and he breaks free in a burst of light.
timeline.quote: but the stone column simply swallowed him.

citation.text: "Stone and Blood" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Sorin binds Nahiri with a beam of moonlight, and she realizes the moon is made of silver like the Helvault.
timeline.quote: It was made of silver. Like the Helvault.

citation.text: "Stone and Blood" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Nahiri forges a sword from stone and demands Sorin return with her to Zendikar.
timeline.quote: You will return with me to Zendikar.

citation.text: "Stone and Blood" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Sorin stops Nahiri's sword with his own and explains the angel is the other half.
timeline.quote: The other half,

citation.text: "Stone and Blood" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Sorin disarms Nahiri, puts his sword to her throat, then hurls her into the Helvault, which absorbs her.
timeline.quote: Then the Helvault claimed her, and she vanished into a darkness vast and total.

citation.text: "Stone and Blood" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: The angel enters the Helvault to fight the demons and Nahiri realizes Sorin made her.
timeline.quote: He had made her. Just like the Helvault.

citation.text: "Stone and Blood" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Nahiri swears that as Zendikar has bled, so will Innistrad, and as she has wept, so will Sorin.
timeline.quote: As Zendikar has bled, so will Innistrad.

citation.text: "Stone and Blood" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Olivia and Sorin accuse Liliana of freeing the Lithomancer.
timeline.quote: You released the Lithomancer and brought this upon us.

citation.text: "Innistrad's Last Hope" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Sorin threatens Liliana, and she answers that death is hers.
timeline.quote: Innistrad may be your domain, Sorin,

citation.text: "Innistrad's Last Hope" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Olivia calls Sorin outside, saying Nahiri awaits.
timeline.quote: Join me outside. Nahiri awaits.

citation.text: "Innistrad's Last Hope" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Sorin says the world is ruined and that Jace will die at Thraben.
timeline.quote: This world is ruined,

citation.text: "Innistrad's Last Hope" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Sorin and Olivia lead the Voldaren vampire army off to battle Nahiri, not to help the people.
timeline.quote: The vampire army marched off down the hill, swords and pikes and red-hot priest symbols held high

citation.text: "Innistrad's Last Hope" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Sorin's vampire army arrives with banners and knights opposite the manor.
timeline.quote: The first of Sorin's forces to arrive were the banners, ancient cloths that hung from black wooden poles

citation.text: "Campaign of Vengeance" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Nahiri steps out sword in hand to welcome Sorin.
timeline.quote: Sword in hand, Nahiri stepped out into the dull light of the day

citation.text: "Campaign of Vengeance" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Nahiri raises stone walls to create a passage between her and Sorin and impales vampires and cultists on stone quills.
timeline.quote: on either side of her, two parallel walls rose up a dozen feet from the floor.

citation.text: "Campaign of Vengeance" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Sorin launches death magic at Nahiri, but it veers away and strikes him, because magic flows through leylines and stone.
timeline.quote: They suddenly broke apart, and flew in several directions, tracing contours in the air that were otherwise invisible.

citation.text: "Campaign of Vengeance" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Nahiri tells Sorin she brought Emrakul to his doorstep.
timeline.quote: I brought Emrakul to your doorstep, and you still think I'm a child.

citation.text: "Campaign of Vengeance" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Nahiri declares she is done being a warden and that Zendikar will never again be a prison, so Emrakul had to go somewhere.
timeline.quote: I'm done being a warden, and Zendikar will never again be a prison.

citation.text: "Campaign of Vengeance" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Olivia arrives overhead with vampire knights and says she cannot allow Nahiri her revenge.
timeline.quote: But he's also earned my help, so I can't allow you your revenge.

citation.text: "Campaign of Vengeance" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Olivia and her vampires wade into the monsters while Sorin pursues Nahiri through the floating ruins.
timeline.quote: By the time Nahiri was among the unmoored, broken remnants of the manor's vaulted ceiling, Sorin was on her heels.

citation.text: "Campaign of Vengeance" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Nahiri upends a landing under Sorin, but he swings and escapes.
timeline.quote: Nahiri grabbed hold of the landing with her will and upended it.

citation.text: "Campaign of Vengeance" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Sorin's blade breaches the stone and stabs Nahiri in the side.
timeline.quote: Then there was a loud crack, and agony shot through her side like a hot poker.

citation.text: "Campaign of Vengeance" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Sorin stands over wounded Nahiri, saying she should have killed him when she had the chance.
timeline.quote: You had the chance to kill me, young one.

citation.text: "Campaign of Vengeance" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Sorin bites Nahiri's neck and drinks her blood.
timeline.quote: Before a muscle could even twitch, she felt Sorin's teeth tear into her neck.

citation.text: "Campaign of Vengeance" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Nahiri drives stone tusks into Sorin and traps him in a stone cocoon.
timeline.quote: The stone crashed in around them, and rows of jagged stone tusks tore into Sorin from his legs to his ribs.

citation.text: "Campaign of Vengeance" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Nahiri whispers that she spared him, a courtesy returned.
timeline.quote: I spared you," Nahiri said. "A courtesy returned.

citation.text: "Campaign of Vengeance" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Nahiri planeswalks away from Innistrad, leaving Sorin trapped.
timeline.quote: Nahiri planeswalked away from Innistrad, leaving Sorin to the fate of his world.

citation.text: "Campaign of Vengeance" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Sorin, trapped, watches Emrakul drift across Gavony toward Thraben.
timeline.quote: The horizon was Emrakul.

citation.text: "Campaign of Vengeance" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Olivia taunts Sorin, declares the bargain fulfilled, and leaves him trapped.
timeline.quote: Avacyn is dead. Nahiri has been driven off. Our bargain is fulfilled.

citation.text: "Campaign of Vengeance" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Olivia pushes Sorin's sword against his cheek and floats away, leaving him in stone.
timeline.quote: you're where you are. I think it's quite good.

citation.text: "Campaign of Vengeance" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Nahiri confronts Sorin, blaming him for what he brought on himself.
timeline.quote: You brought this upon yourself, Sorin!

citation.text: Nahiri's Wrath (Eldritch Moon, 2016), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Sorin vows the world cannot be saved but will have bloody vengeance.
timeline.quote: There is no saving this world, not anymore.

citation.text: Campaign of Vengeance (Eldritch Moon, 2016), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Sorin kills Avacyn and Emrakul enters Innistrad, corrupting the remaining angels into the Flight of Nightmares led by Brisela.
timeline.quote: After Avacyn's death at the hands of her creator Sorin , Emrakul successfully entered Innistrad

citation.text: "Angel", section "The Flight of Nightmares". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At Thraben Cathedral Avacyn overpowers Jace and Tamiyo, then Sorin arrives and tells her he is her creator.
timeline.quote: Sorin told her that he was her creator, and Avacyn's madness momentarily withdrew

citation.text: "Avacyn", section "The Unmaking of Avacyn". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sorin plummets Avacyn into the Vault of the Archangel and unravels the spell that formed her; her last words are that she is to protect.
timeline.quote: I am Avacyn. I am to protect.

citation.text: "Avacyn", section "The Unmaking of Avacyn". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Nahiri summons Emrakul to Innistrad to take revenge on Sorin Markov.
timeline.quote: Nahiri has summoned Emrakul to the plane, to take revenge on Sorin Markov .

citation.text: "Eldritch Moon", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sorin saves Jace and Tamiyo from Avacyn in Thraben Cathedral and, after a battle, unmakes his corrupted creation.
timeline.quote: Sorin was forced to unmake his corrupted guardian in the same spot where she was born

citation.text: "Innistrad (plane)", section "Unmaking of Avacyn". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Emrakul arrives on Innistrad; Sorin is beaten and encased in stone by Nahiri, then abandoned by Olivia, who takes his sword.
timeline.quote: where he was bested by the Lithomancer and encased in stone

citation.text: "Innistrad (plane)", section "Unmaking of Avacyn". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sorin destroys Avacyn and Emrakul arrives.
timeline.quote: Sorin Markov showed up and destroyed his creation.

citation.text: "Jace Beleren", section "Unmaking of Avacyn". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sorin returns to find Avacyn gone and Innistrad in chaos; he deals with Tibalt.
timeline.quote: Tibalt posed a significant threat if left unchecked

citation.text: "Sorin Markov", section "Fall of Thraben". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sorin finds Markov Manor ruined by Nahiri and seeks vampire allies, including Olivia Voldaren.
timeline.quote: Nahiri had left this declaration in stone as a warning of her vengeance.

citation.text: "Sorin Markov", section "The Travails". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sorin destroys the corrupted Avacyn in Thraben Cathedral to secure Olivia's help.
timeline.quote: Sorin was forced to unmake his corrupted guardian in the same spot where she was born.

citation.text: "Sorin Markov", section "Unmaking of Avacyn". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Emrakul arrives on Innistrad as Sorin realizes he played into Nahiri's plan.
timeline.quote: Promptly, Emrakul arrived on Innistrad.

citation.text: "Sorin Markov", section "Unmaking of Avacyn". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Nahiri defeats Sorin and encases him in stone; Olivia takes his sword and declares herself lord of Innistrad.
timeline.quote: where he was bested by the Lithomancer and encased in stone

citation.text: "Sorin Markov", section "Unmaking of Avacyn". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jace persuades Tamiyo to confront the mad Avacyn; they nearly lose until Sorin destroys his creation.
timeline.quote: In the end, Sorin Markov showed up and destroyed his creation himself .

citation.text: "Tamiyo", section "Shadows over Innistrad". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Avacyn, corrupted by Emrakul's presence, attacks humanity and is destroyed by her creator Sorin Markov in the Cathedral of Thraben.
timeline.quote: a final confrontation in the Cathedral of Thraben with her creator, Sorin Markov , who ultimately destroyed her

citation.text: "Thraben", section "Unmaking of Avacyyn". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Nahiri destroys Markov Manor, trapping its inhabitants in stone.
timeline.quote: The Markov suffered great losses when the lithomancer Nahiri destroyed Markov Manor, trapping its inhabitants in stone.

citation.text: "Vampire", section "The Four Bloodlines". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sorin's enemies fall victim to his path.
timeline.quote: Many who cross Sorin's path come down with a sudden and fatal case of being-in-the-way-of-a-millennia-old-vampire.

citation.text: Mortify (Commander 2016, 2016), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Edgar Markov creates the curse of vampirism on Innistrad.
timeline.quote: Edgar Markov creates the curse of vampirism on Innistrad with the assistance of the demon Shilgengar

citation.text: "Timeline", section "Time of Legends (-5000 AR to 0 AR) [ 17 ] [ 10 ]". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sorin, Ugin and Nahiri imprison the Eldrazi on Zendikar.
timeline.quote: The Eldrazi are imprisoned on Zendikar by Sorin, Ugin , and Nahiri .

citation.text: "Timeline", section "Time of Legends (-5000 AR to 0 AR) [ 17 ] [ 10 ]". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sorin Markov reflects on decadence of death for vanity and pleasure.
timeline.quote: This is the decadence I sought to curb.

citation.text: Bloodflow Connoisseur (Ultimate Masters, 2018), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Sorin and Nahiri battle across Ravnica.
